mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining by >1% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rates below 5% triggers increased labor market confidence, reducing risk premium and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 5% in the preceding month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 and INDPRO move in opposite directions or both decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate for two consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite FEDFUNDS declining for two months in the late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 140,000 triggers heightened labor market optimism, reducing risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain negative despite PAYEMS exceeding 140,000 in the preceding month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rates (UNRATE) signals robust economic activity, reducing risk premium and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 and UNRATE move in opposite directions or both decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sharp increase in the federal funds rate by over 1% in a month signals higher policy rates, elevating borrowing costs and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >1% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative despite FEDFUNDS rising by >1% in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) over three months signals improved production capacity and reduced inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive despite INDPRO trending upward over three months.
